Similar to robot vacuums, robot lawn mowers are battery-powered, AI-boosted machines that serve as more low-maintenance alternatives to traditional gas mowers.

Why we like it

This powerful Dreame A3 AWD 3500 robot mower has never been cheaper, thanks to a Black Friday on-page coupon that knocks the price down to $1,700.99. Mashable's sister site CNET named this model the best designed robot lawn mower of 2026, which is unsurprising as Dreame's tech is always sleek and futuristic. It features OmniSense 3.0 technology, which combines 360-degree 3D LiDAR and Binocular AI Vision for navigation. CNET's reviewer ensures it maps out lawns quickly and performs well, even dodging obstacles along the way. It can climb slopes up to 38.7 degrees, making it a solid choice for lawns with uneven terrain, and can cover up to 0.87 acres. Just remember to select the on-page coupon to secure the Black Friday discount.
